summary: A chat screen: the conversation above and a composer to write and send the next message
purposes: write and send messages in a conversation

exposes.children.messages.records: The messages shown: link it with <-records to an array in $.data of records { id, author, text, time, streaming }; a reply that streams in is one record whose text is rewritten per chunk, with streaming true until it ends (the row shows a typing indicator meanwhile)
exposes.children.composer.streaming: Link it with <-streaming to a boolean that is true while a reply streams: the send button becomes a stop button that emits chat.stop
exposes.children.composer.suggestions: Prompts offered while the composer is empty: a map of { _label, _prompt }; a press sends the prompt
exposes.children.composer.attach: Whether files can be attached (default true); accept and maxFiles narrow them
exposes.children.composer._placeholder: The hint in the empty composer
exposes.children.composer.on.send: What sending does: the default emits chat.send with { text, attachments } (attachments are file references); rename the target to change the event name. The composer clears itself
exposes.children.composer.on.stop: What the stop button does: the default emits chat.stop
